Due to regulatory restrictions, no direct transport link exists between Warehouse Alpha and Warehouse Beta.
Furthermore, due to a contractual exclusivity clause, the inspection route must incorporate exactly one—and not both—of the following two corridors: the link between Warehouse Beta and Gamma, or the link between Warehouse Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-loop inspection circuit, whereby the courier visits each warehouse precisely once before returning to the origin, thereby minimizing the total distance traversed.
